summary: Verified BarcodeScanner.tsx bug fix (environment-facing camera, DOMException mapping, 8s stuck-timer, manual SKU fallback). All 6 acceptance criteria exercised with named browser checks; all passed, including a re-run against the public preview URL confirming the fix is live there too.

checks.name: scanner-facingmode-environment
checks.evidence: Stubbed navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia via addInitScript before navigation; logged in as master, opened /inventory, clicked scan-button, captured constraints passed to getUserMedia: video.facingMode.ideal === 'environment' and audio === false. Confirmed both on localhost and re-run against https://thrift-vision.preview.emergentagent.com.

checks.criterion: Scanner shows the specific permission-denied message on NotAllowedError
checks.name: scanner-notallowed-permission-denied
checks.evidence: Stubbed getUserMedia to reject with DOMException('denied','NotAllowedError'); [data-testid=scanner-error] text contained 'Camera permission denied' and did NOT contain the generic 'Camera unavailable' fallback.

checks.criterion: Scanner shows the no-back-camera message on NotFoundError
checks.name: scanner-notfound-no-back-camera
checks.evidence: Stubbed getUserMedia to reject with DOMException('missing','NotFoundError'); scanner-error text contained 'No back camera found'.

checks.criterion: Scanner shows the in-use message on NotReadableError
checks.name: scanner-notreadable-in-use
checks.evidence: Stubbed getUserMedia to reject with DOMException('busy','NotReadableError'); scanner-error text contained 'in use by another app'.

checks.criterion: Stuck-start timeout flips to error after ~8s if getUserMedia never resolves
checks.name: scanner-stuck-timeout-flips-to-error
checks.evidence: Stubbed getUserMedia to return a never-resolving Promise; [data-testid=scanner-error] appeared within the 10s wait window with text containing "Camera didn't start".

checks.criterion: Manual SKU entry still works even when the camera is stuck/denied
checks.name: scanner-manual-sku-entry-works-when-camera-denied
checks.evidence: With getUserMedia stubbed to reject (NotAllowedError), typed a 12-digit SKU into manual-sku-input and clicked manual-sku-submit; onDetected fired through to resolveScannedCode (visible 404 network call in console), surfacing the 'No item matches that barcode' toast — confirms the manual path is reachable independent of camera state.
